assessment: A-level tool-first page for "link preview" (1900/mo, KD 18): the Link Preview is the first screen, the 46-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "og preview", "open graph preview", "linkedin preview", "url preview", "social share preview" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "link preview" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Open Graph protocol: four required properties og:title, og:type, og:image, og:url; og:image:width/height.
LinkedIn shared-link images: minimum 1200x627, ratio 1.91:1, max 5 MB.
LinkedIn Post Inspector shows and refreshes how LinkedIn reads a URL.
Meta recommends at least 1200x630, ~1.91:1, max 8 MB; 600x315 minimum for large cards; images cached by URL.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (5 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 366 words, 2 Pexels images, 3 inline source links, 3 internal links, 3 FAQs, 5 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.
Exercised POST /api/tools/link-preview against live public sites on the local build and confirmed a structured result (verdict, headline, sections) renders on the page.
